releases.title: Easier-to-scan alerts
changes: Larger titles, quieter previews, and clearer unread styling make busy alert lists easier to scan without changing time order.
Color-marked names identify people in the owner timeline. Compact rows and optional person grouping remain.

employee.title: Easier-to-scan alerts
changes: Larger titles, quieter previews, and clearer unread styling make alerts easier to read while keeping rows compact.

releases.title: Alerts in time order
changes: Alerts open newest first across people. Switch View to Grouped by person when needed.
Today, Yesterday, and older date labels show when each alert arrived in 12-hour studio time.

employee.title: Clearer alert times
changes: Alerts show newest first with Today, Yesterday, and older date labels in 12-hour studio time.

releases.title: Editable pay and easier staffing
changes: Edit manual pay descriptions, dates, amounts, and notes while preserving payments and advance credit. Entries group by person and date with search and Paid/Owed filters.
See daily availability together. Rental suggestions prioritize preferred hours and exclude conflicts and existing invitations; you choose and send offers.
Rental checklists remain under Resources and are removed from appointment details.

releases.title: Clearer overnight event entry
changes: Event, crew coverage, and availability forms use separate Date and Time fields to avoid combined date-picker errors. Overnight events can end on the following day and stay listed under their starting day.
An optional end needs both a date and a time once entered. Leave both blank when the end is unknown.

releases.title: Retrieve activated team logins
changes: Smooth can view or copy existing team login details in Settings → Preferences → Team logins. Choose a person first; passwords stay hidden until revealed and are hidden again when the panel closes.

releases.title: Multiple email addresses for one team account
changes: New employee setup accepts multiple email addresses for one person. Calendar invitations to any saved address match the same employee, with one login and one earnings record.
The first address is the default for invitations; a connected Google address takes priority. Setup checks that addresses are valid and do not belong to another team member.
Reduced database queries when reviewing team check-ins and adjusting SmoothStars so those controls keep working as the team grows.

releases.title: Apple Calendar subscriptions
changes: Appointment details and Settings now offer an Apple Calendar subscription. Each employee sees their assigned rentals and scheduled work; Smooth can subscribe to studio appointments.

Time and detail changes use the same event, and removed appointments leave the subscription when Apple refreshes. Pending work is labeled clearly; accepting or declining still happens in the dashboard.
Subscription links are private, read-only, and can be turned off in Settings. Apple controls refresh timing, so updates may be delayed.

employee.title: See your work in Apple Calendar
changes: Open an appointment → Apple Calendar, or use Settings → Apple Calendar → Set up Apple Calendar. Open Apple Calendar and confirm the subscription once.
Your assigned work stays updated when Apple refreshes. Keep accepting or declining offers in the dashboard. Turn off sync in Settings when needed.

releases.title: Daily actions and simpler appointment workflows
changes: Built on the restored v2.41.1: Home starts with today’s work, pending responses, and decisions. Financial summary and reports stay collapsed; custom Home ordering remains available.
Home, Schedule, and rental alerts open the same appointment panel with details, team responses, payment review, relevant actions, and a shared rental checklist.

Required fields come first, optional fields are under More options, and new person selectors start blank. Saving and Saved feedback, retries, consistent actions, and reachable close buttons clarify each change.

employee.title: Your next steps in one place
changes: Home prioritizes your next rental, offers to accept, and work to submit. Earnings stay collapsed.
Open a rental to review its details and complete its shared crew checklist. Optional form fields are under More options, and saved changes show a confirmation.

releases.title: Restored v2.41.1
changes: Restored the v2.41.1 dashboard, including its previous sign-in and loading behavior. Current studio records and team accounts are preserved.

employee.title: Dashboard version restored
changes: The dashboard has returned to v2.41.1. Reload the page and sign in again.

releases.title: Lighter loading and coordinated refreshes
changes: Sign-in includes the initial Home data in one response. Unchanged background checks no longer download the dashboard again.
Home loads recent appointment details and a compact financial ledger. Full appointment, payout, and report history loads when opened, preserving all totals and previous weeks.
Overlapping reads share one request per account. Saves invalidate pending shared reads so the next refresh retrieves fresh information.

employee.title: Lighter dashboard loading
changes: Sign-in and background refresh use fewer requests and less data. Earlier appointment and earnings details load when you open them.

releases.title: Protected sign-in and private dashboard data
changes: Dashboard sign-in now uses expiring sessions that renew while the app is open. Sign out revokes that session, and account password changes invalidate existing sessions.
Private dashboard snapshots and account settings load through authenticated storage. Background sync publishes encrypted updates directly to the API instead of public website files.
Password and quick sign-in still open Home. An ended session returns to sign-in with a clear message.

employee.title: Secure sign-in sessions
changes: Keep using your password or quick sign-in. If your session expires, sign in again to return to Home. Sign out when you finish on a shared device.

releases.title: Prepare expiring sign-in sessions
changes: Added expiring, revocable server sessions and protected encrypted dashboard storage for the sign-in upgrade.
Replaced vulnerable development dependencies with a bounded local pattern-parser patch and an updated build dependency.

releases.title: Stronger access checks and request protection
changes: Rental checklist access ends as soon as a person is removed, including while Calendar is catching up. Employee checklist data excludes other people’s Calendar responses.
Updated dependencies and added request throttling, with expanded tests for restricted actions and invalid requests.

releases.title: Choose when to join an event
changes: Plan crew shows Add myself (Smooth) first. Select it and save to join an event. Smooth is no longer listed in automatic availability suggestions; saved crew choices remain unchanged.

releases.title: Edit creative work and assign multiple people
changes: Assign creative work to multiple people with clear pay per person and one shared card. Each person accepts, submits, earns, and receives payment separately.
Use Edit work to update an active assignment, or Add people to invite more teammates. Changes to accepted assignments require acceptance again; approved earnings stay protected.

employee.title: Updated creative assignments
changes: Creative assignments keep your own acceptance, submission, and pay. If assignment terms change after you accept, review and accept the updated offer.

releases.title: Always start on Home after sign-in
changes: Password and quick sign-in always open Home, even when the address still points to another tab or notification. Alerts continue opening their related pages while signed in.

employee.title: Sign-in opens Home
changes: Every sign-in starts on Home. Open Alerts afterward to view a notification’s related item.

releases.title: Clearer check-in dates
changes: Check-in cards and history show Today or Yesterday for recent entries, and the calendar date for older entries. Times stay visible in 12-hour format and day labels follow studio time.

employee.title: Clearer check-in dates
changes: Recent Temp Checks show Today or Yesterday beside the time; older entries keep their date.

releases.title: BTS checklist steps and rental balance reminders
changes: Add Record a BTS video, Post BTS video to Content Vault, and Ask for the trigger back to the shared rental checklist while preserving existing owner edits.
Notify confirmed rental staff once in the final ten minutes if recent Stripe/Calendar payment records show a remaining balance.
Skip paid-in-full bookings, unknown or stale payment totals, and unaccepted or removed staff. Keep an inbox record and prevent duplicate pushes across checks.

employee.title: BTS steps and checkout reminders
changes: Record BTS, post it to Content Vault, and ask for the trigger back before checkout.
Receive a remaining-balance reminder during the final minutes of a rental when saved payment records confirm an amount is owed.

releases.title: Alert navigation and payment workflow safeguards
changes: Deleting, restoring, and marking alerts unread keep their confirmed results when you switch tabs while the save finishes.
The dashboard stays usable when browser storage is blocked; appearance changes still work for the current session.
Payment cutoffs use the studio date and reject impossible or future dates. Payment overrides reject missing inputs before changing data.
Queued payment workflows start from the latest saved data and handle owner-entered values as literal inputs.

employee.title: Alerts stay consistent when switching pages
changes: Alert deletion, Undo, and Mark all → Unread keep updating your inbox and badge while you move between tabs.
The dashboard stays usable when browser storage is blocked.

releases.title: Calendar sync and planner recovery fixes
changes: Concurrent Google Calendar connection checks share one token refresh instead of briefly reporting a missing connection.
Calendar full imports reject older snapshots and preserve other uploads still in progress.

Event Planner resumes background updates after closing availability notes. Correctable form errors keep editing available, invalid coverage times show an error, and import errors stay visible in the dialog.
Period totals use studio time across month and daylight-saving boundaries. Manual pay belongs to its work date rather than its later recording date.
Rental checklist saves now reject a concurrent staffing or checklist-template change instead of using outdated access.

employee.title: More reliable Calendar updates
changes: Improved Calendar connection checks and protection against outdated schedule imports.
Earnings period totals follow studio time and the work date for training or other manual pay.

releases.title: More efficient event planning
changes: Event Planner reuses crew availability and conflict checks while you browse, search, and edit. Refreshing the plan or schedule replaces those results, and changing coverage recalculates the affected crew checks.
Separated planner loading, forms, and calculations into focused components while preserving current scheduling and override behavior.

releases.title: Override a crew conflict when planning
changes: Use Override & add in Plan crew to select someone despite a listed conflict. The saved plan keeps the conflict visible and labels the override.

Overrides apply to the selected person, event coverage, and conflicts reviewed. Changed conflicts or coverage need another review. Availability, Calendar bookings, work offers, and earnings stay unchanged.

releases.title: Include Smooth in event plans
changes: Smooth is shown with a flexible schedule in Availability and Event Planner. Add yourself through Plan crew and see your name on saved events, without setting fixed working hours. Your unavailable time and existing commitments still flag conflicts.

releases.title: Overnight events stay on their starting day
changes: Event Planner keeps each event, studio booking, and task on the day it starts, including day counts and crew summaries. Overnight availability and conflict checks still include the full scheduled time.

releases.title: Enter the crew size you need
changes: Type the number of people needed in Add event, Edit event, or Plan crew. Crew size is no longer limited to one or two people. Editing the number keeps your crew selections; remove a selected person before saving a smaller crew.

releases.title: Event Planner opens on today
changes: Event Planner starts on today in studio time when opened or resumed. Importing a plan also returns to today. Open forms and ordinary background data updates keep the date you are working on.

releases.title: AM/PM times in crew availability
changes: Event Planner availability details and crew conflict messages now show 12-hour AM/PM times, including times in saved notes. For example, 18:05 appears as 6:05 PM and 00:00 as 12:00 AM.

releases.title: Read alerts stay read when you return
changes: Opening a phone notification now marks its inbox alert read, so it stays read after signing out and back in. Receiving a notification alone leaves it unread; retrying an old receipt preserves an intentional Mark all → Unread action.
Unread badges update after a phone notification is opened and after an in-app alert opens another tab. Saved read status is kept when navigating away.
Removed the introductory heading and slogan from Event Planner, bringing its controls and calendar to the top.

employee.title: Read alerts stay read
changes: Opening an alert from your phone or inside the dashboard saves its read status for your next sign-in. Unread badges update when you open the related page.

releases.title: A clearer event planner, built for phones
changes: Scan a compact full week, clearer event cards, and available crew at a glance. Secondary filters and import/export tools stay tucked away until needed.
On mobile, switch between Day’s events and Crew today, use larger touch targets, and plan coverage in forms sized for your screen.

releases.title: Save event plans from the dashboard
changes: Event imports, availability notes, and crew choices now save correctly from the live dashboard. If an earlier attempt failed, reload the planner and try again.

releases.title: Google Calendar connection repair
changes: Fixed the server request issue that prevented Google Calendar from connecting after approval. The same correction applies to invitations, RSVP updates, token renewal, and disconnection.

Connection failures now explain the next step, such as retrying, approving missing Calendar access, or choosing the account that can edit the studio Calendar. Uploaded Google setup stays saved for a retry.

employee.title: Google Calendar connection repair
changes: Google Calendar can finish connecting after approval. If connection fails, Settings explains what to check before trying again.

releases.title: Event coverage and saved pay options
changes: Event Planner shows daily events alongside live Calendar bookings and studio tasks. Choose one or two crew members, adjust coverage hours, and see availability, pending offers, and overlapping plans before saving.

Add guest crew and date-specific availability notes. Unknown availability and missing end times stay visible. Plans save privately across devices and support import, export, editing and archiving. Crew plans do not send work offers or change earnings.
Add pay now lets you create named work types and reuse them across devices. Adding a work type does not create an earning or payment.
Advance review shows rental completion, customer payment, and pay setup checks, with direct links to payment correction and Calendar sync. Existing advance credit stays preserved.

releases.title: Sporadic Temp Checks and clearer notification delivery
changes: Temp Checks use a varied 60–100 minute interval shared across visits and devices. Reopening the app does not repeat the same popup; responses and skips start a fresh interval. Daily Quiz timing stays the same.

Alerts → Delivery shows each person’s registered devices and recent alerts, separating push-service acceptance, confirmed device receipt, and deliberate opens. Older or unconfirmed alerts are never labeled delivered without evidence.

Temporary push failures retry with increasing spacing, successful devices stay deduplicated, and expired or rejected subscriptions are flagged. Alert navigation proceeds even if its read-status update fails. Employees should reopen the updated app once for new device receipts.
Automatic sync requests use the redirect mode supported by the server runtime, correcting the issue found during unattended verification.

employee.title: Occasional check-ins and more reliable alerts
changes: Temp Checks appear occasionally across visits, with a varied 60–100 minute interval. Checking the app repeatedly does not keep reopening the same popup.
Reopen the app once to update notifications. Smooth can see when a device confirms receiving an alert or you open it. That status does not say you read the full message.
Alert links still open their page if saving the read status is temporarily unavailable.

releases.title: Manual pay, blank assignment choices, and more reliable background sync
changes: Add pay in Payouts records onboarding, training, and other completed work. Choose the person, date, amount, and whether it is still owed or already paid. Totals and payment details update without transferring money. Existing advances remain limited to their own person.
New rental and creative assignments start with a blank employee selection. Existing offer edits retain their assigned employee.

A five-minute server trigger starts due Calendar and payment imports without relying on delayed GitHub scheduled starts. Duplicate-run protection and incremental imports remain in place. Visible dashboards quietly check for new published data every 30 seconds.

employee.title: Additional pay and faster data updates
changes: Onboarding, training, and other pay added by Smooth appear in Earnings with their payment status. Pay alerts open their details.
Published Calendar and payment updates are checked more often while the app is open. Forms and scroll position stay in place.

releases.title: Clearer alerts, reliable notification taps, and flexible submissions
changes: Phone notifications open the related tab, including Availability updates, repeated taps, and after sign-in. Notification times omit EDT and EST while keeping studio time. The iPhone’s own app-name subtitle remains controlled by iOS.
Touching or scrolling over cards and buttons no longer triggers sticky hover highlighting. Keyboard focus and selected states remain visible.

Creative submissions can be sent without review links for physical work or any task that does not need them. Notes remain optional; Smooth still reviews and approves completed work before earnings are added.

employee.title: Smoother taps and easier work submissions
changes: Phone notifications open their related tab, even after sign-in. Notification times are shorter.
Touching or scrolling over cards no longer leaves a hover highlight.
Submit work without a link when there are no files to review. You can add optional notes about what you completed.

releases.title: See exactly what needs an advance review
changes: A compact, named Advance review row replaces the large generic payout warning. Review opens the affected person, rental or creative task, saved credit, current earning, and the reason it was flagged.

Open rental or Open task goes to the current record. Removed records retain their reference without inventing missing history. Check again reads the latest details; existing advance credits and pay amounts stay unchanged.

releases.title: Fresh data without interrupting your page
changes: The signed-in dashboard checks for fresh published data every minute while visible, when you return, and after reconnecting. Updates stay quiet and keep your current page, scroll position, filters, and form entries. Open editors and pickers defer snapshot changes until a later check.

Manual refresh and automatic snapshot checks share in-flight reads. Unchanged encrypted data skips decryption, older snapshots cannot replace newer data, and offline failures keep the last usable information. Server imports remain on their existing five-minute schedule.
Payment review and Stripe matching keep your selections and search text when updated records arrive.

employee.title: Your dashboard updates quietly
changes: Fresh information loads automatically while you use the dashboard and when you return, without jumping to the top or showing a refresh animation. Your open page and entries stay in place; pull down whenever you want to check immediately.

releases.title: Less database writing during automatic sync
changes: Five-minute Calendar and payroll checks save only new, changed, or removed records. Unchanged rentals and earnings stay in place, including previous weeks of history.

Imports verify the complete result before applying changes together. Incomplete or stale imports preserve the saved schedule and payroll, and rental acceptance and advance accounting keep their existing safeguards.

releases.title: Adding rental time keeps the assignment
changes: Changing only a rental’s end time keeps its assigned people and their existing accepted or pending responses, including updates recorded during or after the session. Synced hours and earnings use the updated rental details under the existing payment rules.
Actual start-time reschedules still require review or a new response. Explicit cancellations and removals remain cancelled.

Earlier automatic cancellations caused by added time are restored only when saved alert history proves the original start and response. Existing cancellation messages are corrected without sending another notification.

employee.title: Extra rental time keeps your response
changes: Adding time to the same rental keeps your existing response. An accepted rental stays accepted when its duration is updated, including after the session.

releases.title: Swipe left to close the sidebar
changes: Swipe left across the open mobile sidebar to close it with the same smooth slide as the menu controls. Swiping over a navigation row closes the menu without opening that page; vertical scrolling and normal taps still work.

employee.title: Swipe left to close the sidebar
changes: Swipe right from the page’s left edge to open the menu, then swipe left across it to close. You can still scroll the menu vertically and tap pages as usual.

releases.title: Easier rental controls and clearer action feedback
changes: Add person opens with its pickers closed until tapped. Shared dialog close buttons have larger touch targets, and booking and assignment exits stay visible while scrolling.
Cancel offer shows an inline confirmation, a saving state, and a clear result inside the booking. Previous offers stays collapsed.

Remove person clears a teammate from an upcoming rental in the app and queues removal of their Google Calendar invitation, including separately added invitations. Connection and review messages stay visible; past earnings and response history are preserved.
Important action buttons provide short haptic feedback on supported browsers, with visible progress and results on every device.

employee.title: Easier exits and clearer buttons
changes: Dialogs open without automatically revealing picker options. Close buttons have larger touch targets.
Important actions provide visible feedback, with short vibrations where the browser supports them.

releases.title: Arrange Home and open alerts directly
changes: Coming up starts at the top of Smooth’s Home. Edit layout lets Smooth reorder all six Home sections and save the order to the account across devices.
Drag handles and move buttons make the layout editor usable with touch, a mouse, or a keyboard. Cancel preserves the saved order, and Reset to default restores the starting arrangement.
The Alerts read and unread bulk actions share one compact Mark all menu.
Opening an alert takes you directly to its relevant rental, assignment, or page. Inbox-only custom messages still open their full text.

employee.title: Simpler alert controls and direct links
changes: Read and Unread bulk actions are under the compact Mark all menu.
Tap a reminder to go directly to its rental, assignment, or related page. Inbox-only messages still show their full text.

releases.title: Mark all alerts unread and steadier reminders
changes: Mark all unread returns saved alerts in your own inbox to Unread, including earlier pages. Deleted alerts stay deleted, and newer arrivals keep their current status.
The Unread view and badges refresh after the bulk change. Mark all read remains beside the new action.
The reminder composer keeps its contents within the dialog while scrolling on a phone.

employee.title: Mark all alerts unread
changes: Use Mark all unread in Alerts to revisit your saved notifications, including earlier pages. Deleted alerts stay deleted.

releases.title: Reminders for rentals and studio tasks
changes: The notification composer starts with common studio reminders: rental responses, upcoming rentals, availability updates, Google Calendar connection, and refreshing the schedule. Custom messages remain available.

Rental reminders use current bookings and confirmed staff. The app checks selected times and recipients again before saving an upcoming-rental reminder; pending-response reminders still require a current pending offer.
Reminder text and destinations are filled in for you. Availability reminders open Availability directly, and Calendar connection reminders open Settings.
Smooth can open the composer from Alerts or Team → People; sent history and duplicate-safe retry behavior remain available.

employee.title: Clearer studio reminders
changes: Studio reminders identify the selected rental or task. Availability reminders can open Availability directly from the notification.

releases.title: Team reminders and immediate page changes
changes: Smooth can send a notification to selected team members from Team → People, choose the page it opens, and review recent sent messages.
Pending upcoming assignments include a Remind button. Reminders are checked against the current assignment response and are limited to one per assignment every five minutes.
Sent reminders appear in the recipient’s Alerts and queue a push for enabled devices. Safe retries do not send duplicates.
Choosing another toolbar tab opens its page immediately and quietly updates its information. Tapping the active tab keeps the smooth return to the top and refresh.

employee.title: Studio reminders and faster tabs
changes: Smooth can send reminders through Alerts and enabled phone notifications. A reminder opens its related page and does not accept an assignment for you.
Changing toolbar tabs opens the new page immediately. Tap the active tab for a smooth return to the top and refresh.

releases.title: Google invitations from app assignments
changes: Google Calendar connections in Settings support native invitations for new app offers attached to Calendar events. Smooth completes the one-time Google app setup and connects the studio Calendar account.
Employees can connect their matching Google accounts so app acceptance or decline updates the native Calendar RSVP. Verified Google responses stay distinct from app responses.
Calendar updates retry in the background without delaying assignment saves or alerts. Status labels identify connections, retries, event changes, and invitations needing review.
Only app-created invitations are removed on cancellation. Events with unrelated guests are held for review before sending guest-list updates. Existing assignment history is not replayed.

employee.title: Connect Google Calendar
changes: Connect your Google account in Settings after Smooth finishes setup. App responses can then update your Google Calendar invitation.
Assignments show Google update status separately from your saved app response. Google acceptance appears only after it is confirmed.

releases.title: Compact availability and Calendar invitations
changes: Availability keeps the team in one panel with collapsed name rows and an employee picker. Open one person at a time to see their preferred and unavailable times.
Availability sections show three entries initially, with Show N more and Show less controls for longer lists. Existing entry actions and the past-entry filter remain available.
Alerts no longer show mouse hover shading during touch scrolling. Swipe gestures do not activate an alert or menu action, and menus open after an intentional tap.

Mapped Google Calendar rental guests appear in the live schedule, including pending and tentative invitations. Calendar RSVP status stays distinct from app responses; pending guests do not add confirmed hours or earnings.

employee.title: Clearer touch scrolling
changes: Alerts no longer show mouse hover shading while you scroll. Swipe gestures do not open alerts or menu actions.
Long availability lists show three entries initially; use Show N more or Show less to control the list.
Your Google Calendar rental invitations appear in the app with their Calendar response status, including pending and tentative invitations.

releases.title: Compact alert rows with Delete and Undo
changes: Alerts organize title, message, and time/status into compact rows while preserving named person groups.
Each alert’s More menu includes opening its details, marking it read, and deleting it. Undo restores the most recently deleted alert while its notice is available.
Deletions stay in your account across devices and do not remove the related booking, task, or quiz.

employee.title: Manage your alerts
changes: Alerts organize title, message, and time/status into compact rows while preserving named person groups.
Each alert’s More menu includes opening its details, marking it read, and deleting it. Undo restores the most recently deleted alert while its notice is available.
Deletions stay in your account across devices and do not remove the related booking, task, or quiz.

releases.title: Quieter tab changes and simpler payouts
changes: Changing mobile toolbar tabs loads current information quietly. The visible refresh is reserved for tapping the active tab or pulling the page.
Active-tab refresh glides to the top with an overlaid indicator, removing the extra downward shift.
Payouts uses Amount owed for remaining earned pay. Person summaries are simple divider rows inside one panel, with no nested cards.
Team hours identifies its source as scheduled Calendar appointments and dashboard tasks, rather than clock-in records.

employee.title: Quieter tab changes
changes: Changing mobile toolbar tabs loads current information quietly. The visible refresh is reserved for tapping the active tab or pulling the page.
Active-tab refresh glides to the top with an overlaid indicator, removing the extra downward shift.

releases.title: Weekly hours history and smoother navigation
changes: Mobile toolbar taps smoothly slide the current page to the top before opening and refreshing the selected page, including the active tab.
The glide eases into its finish, stops when you interact with the page, and follows your device’s Reduce Motion setting.
Team hours includes previous- and next-week controls and a This week shortcut, using completed accepted work from the recorded schedule.
Pay cards show Paid separately from Advance applied. Advance credit appears only on the person’s own earnings and never reduces someone else’s pay.

employee.title: Smooth return to the top
changes: Mobile toolbar taps smoothly slide the current page to the top before opening and refreshing the selected page, including the active tab.
The glide eases into its finish, stops when you interact with the page, and follows your device’s Reduce Motion setting.

releases.title: Tidier mobile summaries and booking details
changes: Weekly team hours fit inside their card, with room for names and totals on small screens.
Alerts use slimmer tappable rows with a checkmark to mark an alert read; named person groups remain.
Temp Check and SmoothStars open on Overview, with separate Manage and History views. Large close and Done buttons stay visible while the panel scrolls.
Every mobile toolbar selection returns to the top and refreshes, including tapping the active page.
Rental descriptions show booking contact information, listed price, paid-online amount, the rental form name, and setup answers for the owner and assigned team.

employee.title: Compact alerts and complete rental details
changes: Alerts are slimmer. Tap a row to open it or use its checkmark to mark it read.
Tap a mobile toolbar tab to return to the top and refresh, even when already on that page.
Rental descriptions include booking contact information, listed price, paid-online amount, and rental form answers.
My SmoothStars has a larger close button and a Done button that stay visible while scrolling.

releases.title: Clearer team summaries and mobile controls
changes: Home shows completed scheduled hours for each team member in the current Monday–Sunday week.
Payouts shows each person’s earned total, amount to pay, and settled earnings, including approved creative work and applied advances.
Availability keeps each person’s preferred and unavailable times together. Owner alerts have named, color-marked groups.
Check-in management controls start closed and do not focus the action selector when a person opens. Team cards no longer offer password copying.
Pull-to-refresh works when the gesture starts on a button or card. Routine Refresh buttons and repeated headings are removed; error retry actions remain.
Time-block reasons start blank with a general placeholder. Rental descriptions include available setup answers from the booking.

employee.title: Rental details and smoother refresh
changes: Open a rental to read available setup details alongside preparation instructions.
Pull down from a button or card at the top of a page to refresh; a tap still works normally.
Routine Refresh buttons are removed. Time-block reasons start blank with a general placeholder.

releases.title: Dashboard sections separated for safer maintenance
changes: Separated navigation, sign-in, financial summaries, appointments, team cards, payouts, and payment forms into focused modules while retaining their existing screens and behavior.
Shared formatting and display-status helpers now live in one place; authentication, scheduling recovery, payment calculations, and live data integrations retain their existing behavior.
Added component rendering and shared-helper regression tests alongside the existing scheduling tests.

releases.title: Cleaner scheduling code and automated regression checks
changes: Separated schedule-write recovery, duplicate time-block detection, and response messages from the scheduling screen into a reusable module without changing the interface.
Added regression tests for stale schedule saves, repeat blocks, owner/employee identity handling, and non-retryable changes.
Dashboard publication now runs the test suite before deploying, so test failures stop the release.

releases.title: Time blocks recover when the schedule updates
changes: When saving a new blocked-time entry finds a newer schedule revision, the dashboard retrieves the current schedule and retries once without clearing the form.
Before retrying it checks for an identical existing block, preventing a recurring commitment from being added twice.
If a second schedule change interrupts the retry, the form stays open with a clearer next step. Assignment responses, overrides, and deletions retain their original concurrency checks.

employee.title: Smoother time-block saving
changes: If your schedule updates while you save a new unavailable-time block, the dashboard refreshes it and retries once without losing the dates, hours, or reason.
An already-saved matching block is not added again. If the schedule changes twice, the form stays open so you can try again.

releases.title: Quicker refresh return and a gentler toolbar
changes: After a successful pull-to-refresh, the Refreshed confirmation clears after a brief pause and the page slides back up sooner.
The mobile toolbar stays visible through short downward scrolls, then slides fully below the screen without fading. An upward scroll brings it back.

employee.title: Quicker refresh return and a gentler toolbar
changes: After a successful pull-to-refresh, the Refreshed confirmation clears after a brief pause and the page slides back up sooner.
The mobile toolbar stays visible through short downward scrolls, then slides fully below the screen without fading. An upward scroll brings it back.

releases.title: Pull to refresh and smoother mobile navigation
changes: Pull down at the top of a mobile page to refresh its latest available data while keeping the account signed in, the current page, and filters.
The mobile toolbar tracks finger movement more smoothly, slides away while scrolling down, and returns on an upward scroll.
The three-line menu button sits at the top left. The sidebar backdrop fades in and out with the drawer.
The phone sidebar scrolls within its fixed header and footer without stretching past the ends. Scrolling over another tab no longer leaves a false selected highlight.
Team → People uses smaller cards with compact pay totals and a single-line next accepted date. The repeated status badge and oversized spacing are removed.
Help explains pull-to-refresh, the hiding toolbar, and the five-minute Calendar and Stripe import schedule.

employee.title: Refresh with a pull and smoother navigation
changes: Pull down at the top of a mobile page to refresh its latest available data while keeping the account signed in, the current page, and filters.
The mobile toolbar tracks finger movement more smoothly, slides away while scrolling down, and returns on an upward scroll.
The three-line menu button sits at the top left. The sidebar backdrop fades in and out with the drawer.
The phone sidebar scrolls within its fixed header and footer without stretching past the ends. Scrolling over another tab no longer leaves a false selected highlight.

releases.title: Slide between mobile tabs
changes: The owner toolbar is Home, Team, Schedule, Alerts, and Payouts from left to right, with Schedule centered.
